In this chapter we look at one small habit that keeps code flexible when requirements change: write the test that describes the behaviour before you touch the structure.

books.title: Paper Boats in the Gutter
books.author: Wren Alvarado
books.description: Poems about childhood summers and the rain that always ends them. Spare, musical and easy to carry in a coat pocket.
books.excerpt:
Morning arrives in the kitchen first,
the kettle clearing its throat,
the window wearing yesterday's rain
like a coat it forgot to return.

Somewhere near the river gate
someone is learning to whistle
and getting it wrong
in exactly the right key.
